# Static glTF import fixtures

`external/` contains two tiny unmodified licensed upstream assets and their
pinned closure manifest. Synthetic cases generated by `gltf_tests.cpp` and
`gltf_bundle_tests.cpp` are original GPL-3.0-only project fixtures. They isolate
malformed JSON/framing, accessor/scene rules, sparse/strided data, signed tangents,
resource limits and relocation. Temporary generated payloads are not corpus assets.
